title: secrétaire médical-e
company: Hôpital ophtalmique Jules-Gonin (Fondation Asile des aveugles)

descriptionByLocale.it:
Fondée à Lausanne en 1843, la Fondation Asile des aveugles inclut l'Hôpital ophtalmique Jules-Gonin, service universitaire d'ophtalmologie, un centre de recherche, le Centre pédagogique pour élèves handicapés de la vue (CPHV), le service social, réadaptation et basse vision et l'établissement médico-social Clair-Soleil. Plus de 650 collaborateurs se mobilisent chaque jour au service de la santé visuelle pour offrir des prestations de diagnostic, de traitement et d'accompagnement aux personnes atteintes dans leur vision.

Afin de compléter notre équipe, nous recherchons un-e

secrétaire médical-e

Votre mission

• Accueillir et effectuer l'admission des patients

• Planifier et organiser des rendez-vous, interventions chirurgicales et examens

• Garantir la gestion administrative des dossiers patients

• Gérer les factures et les encaissements des consultations

• Effectuer la dactylographie des rapports et autres correspondances

• Gérer le courrier de l'ensemble du secrétariat

• Gérer les commandes de matériel

Vos atouts

• Titulaire d'un CFC d'assistante médicale, ou d'employée de commerce, diplôme de secrétariat médical ou formation jugée équivalente

• Au bénéfice d'une expérience de secrétaire médicale confirmée. Expérience hospitalière un atout

• Parfaite maîtrise de la langue française, un bon niveau d'orthographe est exigé.

• Sens du détail et de l'organisation, rigueur et conscience professionnelle

• Résistance au stress, qualité relationnelle, esprit d'équipe

Nous vous offrons

Une activité enrichissante au sein d'un environnement dynamique où vous pouvez mettre en valeur vos talents et des conditions salariales en rapport avec vos compétences.
Taux d'activité : 60% réparti les lundis, mardis et jeudis. Ces jours de travail pourront être amenés à changer par la suite.
Nature du contrat : Contrat à durée indéterminée
Entrée en fonction : A convenir
Lieu de travail : Hôpital ophtalmique Jules-Gonin, Lausanne et Centre à Rennaz
Rémunération : Selon les normes DECFO

Renseignements : Claudia Milheirao Co-Responsable Gestion Administrative du Patient , 021 626 81 17

title: Chef-fe de clinique
company: Hôpital ophtalmique Jules-Gonin (Fondation Asile des aveugles)

descriptionByLocale.it:
Fondata a Losanna nel 1843, la Fondazione Asilo per i Ciechi comprende l'Ospedale Ofistico Jules-Gonin, il Servizio Universitario di Oftalmologia, un centro di ricerca, il Centro Pedagogico per Studenti Ipovedenti (CPHV), il Servizio Sociale, di Riabilitazione e Ipovisione e l'Istituto Medico e Sociale di Clair-Soleil. Ogni giorno più di 600 dipendenti vengono mobilitati al servizio della salute visiva per offrire diagnosi, trattamenti e servizi di supporto alle persone con problemi visivi. --- Mansioni - Supervisione dell'attività clinica ambulatoriale e delle emergenze - Gestione della propria consulenza - Supervisione dell'attività clinica degli assistenti medici - Supervisione dell'unità di ricovero - Partecipazione al servizio di reperibilità (chirurgico e/o non chirurgico) - Attività chirurgiche secondo la pianificazione degli orari in sala operatoria
• Requisiti - Titolo di oftalmologo FMH o equivalente (riconoscimento MEBEKO) - Conoscenza del sistema sanitario di Vaud e Swiss - French – Livello minimo B2 - Visione globale e senso di prospettiva - Capacità di decidere, agire e organizzare - Capacità di delegare - Capacità di analizzare e sintetizzare - Impegno personale e tenacia - Flessibilità, abilità interpersonali e capacità di lavorare in squadra
• Cosa offriamo - Un'attività arricchente in un ambiente dinamico dove si possono mettere in mostra i propri talenti e competenze professionali - Beneficiare della formazione post-laurea strutturato secondo i criteri dell'ISFM - Condizioni salariali basate sulle scale del cantone di Vaud --- Detagli del contratto - Tasso di attività: 100% - Natura del contratto: contratto a tempo indeterminato - Durata del contratto: La durata dell'impegno è collegata al piano di formazione per medici assistenti e capi di clinica nel cantone di Vaud, secondo l'art. 10 del Contratto Collettivo di Lavoro del 21.12.2016 - Data di inizio: 01.11.2027 o da definire - Luogo di lavoro: Ospedale Oculistico Jules-Gonin, Losanna --- Contatto - Informazioni: Sig.ra Valentine de Preux, Reparto Medico - Telefono: 021 626 85 82 --- Documenti richiesti per l'assunzione - Estratto dal casellario penale standard e speciale --- Modalità di candidatura - Postulazione esclusivamente online - Richieste complete di candidatura (lettera di presentazione, CV con foto, copie di diplomi e riconoscimento del diploma da parte di MEBEKO, certificati di formazione e competenza in francese livello B2 per chi non parla francese, lettere di raccomandazione, dati di contatto di due referenti e certificati di lavoro)
descriptionByLocale.en:
Founded in Lausanne in 1843, the Asylum for the Blind Foundation includes the Jules-Gonin Ophthalmic Hospital, the University Ophthalmology Service, a research centre, the Pedagogical Centre for Visually Impaired Students (CPHV), the Social, Rehabilitation and Low Vision Service and the Clair-Soleil Medical and Social Establishment. More than 600 employees are mobilized every day in the service of visual health to offer diagnosis, treatment and support services to people with vision problems. --- Mansioni - Supervision of the clinical activity of the outpatient clinic and emergencies - Management of own consultation - Supervision of the clinical activity of assistant doctors - Supervision of the inpatient unit - Participation in the on-call service (surgical and/or non-surgical) - Surgical activities according to the planning of the hours in the operating room
• Requisiti - Title of ophthalmologist FMH or equivalent (MEBEKO recognition) - Knowledge of the Vaud health system and Swiss - French – Minimum B2 level - Global vision and sense of perspective - Ability to decide, act and organize - Ability to delegate - Ability to analyze and synthesize - Personal commitment and tenacity - Flexibility, interpersonal skills and ability to work in a team
• Cosa offriamo - An enriching activity in a dynamic environment where you can showcase your talents and professional skills - Benefit from training postgraduate structured according to the criteria of the ISFM - Salary conditions based on the scales of the canton of Vaud --- Detagli del contratto - Activity rate: 100% - Nature of the contract: Permanent contract - Duration of the contract: The duration of the commitment is linked to the training plan for assistant doctors and heads of clinic in the canton of Vaud, according to art. 10 of the Collective Labour Agreement of 21.12.2016 - Start date: 01.11.2027 or to be defined - Place of work: Jules-Gonin Eye Hospital, Lausanne --- Contatto - Information: Mrs Valentine de Preux, Medical Department - Telephone: 021 626 85 82 --- Documenti richiesti per l'assunzione - Extract from the standard and special criminal record --- Modalità di candidatura - Postulazione esclusivamente online - Complete application richieste (cover letter, CV with photo, copies of diplomas and recognition of the diploma by MEBEKO, certificates of training and proficiency in French level B2 for non-French speakers, letters of recommendation, contact details of two reference persons and work certificates)
descriptionByLocale.de:
Die 1843 in Lausanne gegründete Stiftung Asylum for the Blind umfasst das Jules-Gonin Ophthalmologie-Krankenhaus, den Universitäts-Augenheilkunde-Service, ein Forschungszentrum, das Pädagogische Zentrum für sehbehinderte Studierende (CPHV), den Sozial-, Rehabilitations- und Sehbehinderungsdienst sowie die medizinische und soziale Einrichtung Clair-Soleil. Mehr als 600 Mitarbeiter werden täglich im Dienst der visuellen Gesundheit mobilisiert, um Menschen mit Sehproblemen Diagnose, Behandlung und Unterstützung anzubieten. --- Mansioni – Überwachung der klinischen Tätigkeit der ambulanten Klinik und Notfälle – Verwaltung der eigenen Beratung – Überwachung der klinischen Tätigkeit der Assistenzärzte – Supervision der stationären Station – Teilnahme am Bereitschaftsdienst (chirurgisch und/oder nicht-chirurgisch) – Chirurgische Aktivitäten nach Planung der Arbeitszeiten im Operationssaal
• Requisiti – Titel des Augenarztes FMH oder gleichwertig (MEBEKO-Anerkennung) – Kenntnisse des Waadt-Gesundheitssystems und Schweizer – Französisch – Mindestniveau B2 – Globale Vision und Perspektive – Fähigkeit zu entscheiden, zu handeln und zu organisieren – Fähigkeit zu delegieren – Fähigkeit zu analysieren und zu synthetisieren – Persönliches Engagement und Durchhaltevermögen – Flexibilität, zwischenmenschliche Fähigkeiten und Teamarbeit
• Cosa offriamo – Eine bereichernde Aktivität in einem dynamischen Umfeld, in der Sie Ihre Talente und beruflichen Fähigkeiten präsentieren können – Profitieren von Schulungen Postgraduierter strukturiert nach den Kriterien der ISFM - Gehaltsbedingungen nach den Skalen des Kantons Waadt --- Detagli del contratto - Aktivitätsrate: 100 % - Art des Vertrags: Festanstellung - Vertragsdauer: Die Dauer der Verpflichtung ist gemäß Artikel an den Ausbildungsplan für Assistenzärzte und Klinikleiter im Kanton Waadt gebunden. 10 des Tarifvertrags vom 21.12.2016 - Beginndatum: 01.11.2027 oder noch zu definieren - Arbeitsort: Jules-Gonin Augenklinik, Lausanne --- Contatto - Informationen: Frau Valentine de Preux, Medizinische Abteilung - Telefon: 021 626 85 82 --- Documenti richiesti per l'assunzione - Auszug aus dem Standard- und Sonderstrafregister --- Modalità di candidatura - Postulazione esclusivamente online - Vollständiger Antrag richieste (Anschreiben, Lebenslauf mit Foto, Kopien der Diplome und Anerkennung des Diploms durch MEBEKO, Ausbildungs- und Sprachnachweise auf Französischniveau B2 für Nicht-Französischsprachige, Empfehlungsschreiben, Kontaktdaten von zwei Referenzpersonen und Arbeitszeugnisse)
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Fondée à Lausanne en 1843, la Fondation Asile des aveugles inclut l'Hôpital ophtalmique Jules-Gonin, service universitaire d'ophtalmologie, un centre de recherche, le Centre pédagogique pour élèves handicapés de la vue (CPHV), le service social, réadaptation et basse vision et l'établissement médico-social Clair-Soleil.

Plus de 600 collaborateurs se mobilisent chaque jour au service de la santé visuelle pour offrir des prestations de diagnostic, de traitement et d'accompagnement aux personnes atteintes dans leur vision.

Afin de compléter notre équipe, nous recherchons un-e

Chef-fe de clinique

Votre mission

• Supervision de l'activité clinique de la policlinique et des urgences

• Gestion de sa propre consultation

• Supervision de l'activité clinique des médecins assistants

• Supervision de l'unité d'hospitalisation

• Participation au service de piquet (chirurgical et/ou non-chirurgical)

• Activités chirurgicales selon planification des plages au bloc opératoire

Vos atouts

• Titre d'ophtalmologue FMH ou équivalent (reconnaissance MEBEKO)

• Connaissances du système de santé vaudois et suisse

• Français – Niveau B2 minimum

• Vision globale et sens de la perspective

• Capacité de décision, d'action et d'organisation

• Capacité à déléguer

• Capacité d'analyse et de synthèse

• Engagement personnel et ténacité

• Flexibilité, aisance relationnelle et aptitude à travailler en équipe

Nous vous offrons

Une activité enrichissante au sein d'un environnement dynamique où vous pouvez mettre en valeur vos talents et vos compétences professionnelles, bénéficier d'une formation post-graduée structurée selon les critères de l'ISFM, de conditions salariales basées sur les barèmes du canton de Vaud.

• Taux d'activité : 100%

• Nature du contrat : CDI

• Durée du contrat : La durée de l'engagement est liée au plan de formation des médecins assistants et chefs de clinique vaudois, selon l'art. 10 de la Convention collective de travail du 21.12.2016

• Entrée en fonction : 01.11.2027 ou à définir

• Lieu de travail : Hôpital ophtalmique Jules-Gonin, Lausanne

• Renseignements : Mme Valentine de Preux, Direction médicale 021 626 85 82

n cas d'engagement, vous devrez obligatoirement nous fournir un extrait de casier judiciaire standard et spécial.

En cas d'intérêt pour le poste susmentionné, merci de bien vouloir postuler EXCLUSIVEMENT EN LIGNE et en renseignant tous les champs.

Seules les candidatures complètes (lettre de motivation, CV avec photo, copies des diplômes et reconnaissance du diplôme par la MEBEKO, attestations de formation et de maîtrise du français niveau B2 pour les non francophones, lettres de recommandation, coordonnées de deux personnes de références et certificats de travail) seront prises en considération.

company: Hôpital ophtalmique Jules-Gonin (Fondation Asile des aveugles)

descriptionByLocale.it:
Descrizione Fondata a Losanna nel 1843, la Fondazione Asilo per i Ciechi comprende l'Ospedale Oftalmico Jules-Gonin, un dipartimento universitario di oftalmologia, un centro di ricerca, il Centro Pedagogico per Studenti Ipovedenti (CPHV), il servizio sociale, di riabilitazione e ipovisione e l'istituto medico-sociale Clair-Soleil. Ogni giorno più di 600 dipendenti vengono mobilitati al servizio della salute visiva per offrire diagnosi, trattamenti e servizi di supporto alle persone con problemi visivi. --- Mansioni - Prendersi cura dei pazienti in ambulatorio e pronto soccorso - Partecipare alla rotazione all'interno delle unità specializzate - Collaborare nel servizio di reperibilità - Essere un attore nella propria formazione partecipando a tutti i periodi di insegnamento organizzati dall'Ospedale Oftalmico
• Requisiti - Essere in possesso del Diploma Federale in Medicina Umana o di un riconoscimento ottenuto dalla Commissione delle Professioni Mediche (MEBEKO) - Beneficiare della conoscenza del sistema medico Vaud e Svizzera - Aver completato un anno di formazione opzionale (ricerca in oftalmologia, medicina interna o chirurgia, altro) - Essere fluente in francese sia oralmente che per iscrittura al livello B2 - Avere competenze analitiche, di sintesi e organizzative - Essere pronto a prendere un impegno personale, mostrare tenacia e resistenza allo stress - Essere flessibile, Avere competenze interpersonali e una buona capacità di lavorare in squadra
• Cosa offriamo - Un'attività arricchente in un ambiente dinamico dove si possono mostrare i propri talenti e competenze professionali - Formazione post-laurea strutturata secondo i criteri ISFM - Condizioni salariali basate sulle scale del cantone di Vaud --- Informazioni pratiche - Tasso di attività: 100% - Tipo di contratto: CDI - Durata del contratto: La durata dell'appuntamento è collegata al piano di formazione per medici assistenti e capi di clinica nel cantone di Vaud, in conformità con l'art. 10 del Contratto Collettivo di Lavoro del 21.12.2016 - Data di inizio: 01.11.2027 o da definire - Luogo di lavoro: Jules-Gonin Ophthalmic Hospital, Losanna --- Contatto - Riferimento: Sig.ra Valentine de Preux, Direzione Medica - Telefono: 021 626 85 82 --- Nota importante - In caso di lavoro, dovrete fornirci un estratto standard e speciale dei precedenti penali. - Se sei interessato alla posizione sopra menzionata, ti preghiamo di candidarti ESCLUSIVAMENTE ONLINE e di compilare tutti i campi. - Saranno considerate solo le domande complete (lettera di presentazione, CV con foto, copie dei diplomi e riconoscimento del diploma da parte di MEBEKO, certificati di formazione e competenza in francese livello B2 per non francofoni, lettere di raccomandazione e certificati di lavoro).
descriptionByLocale.en: Descrizione Founded in Lausanne in 1843, the Asylum Foundation of the Blind includes the Jules-Gonin Ophthalmic Hospital, a university department of ophthalmology, a research centre, the Centre pédagogique pour écoles handicapées de la vue (CPHV), the social service, rehabilitation and low vision and the medical-social establishment Clair-Soleil. More than 600 employees work every day in the service of visual health to provide diagnostic, treatment and support services to people with vision. --- Mansioni - Care for patients in the clinic and in emergencies - Participate in tournus within specialized units - Collaborate in the picket service - Be an actor in your training by participating in all periods of teaching organized by the Ophthalmic Hospital --- Required - Be in possession of the Federal Diploma in Human Medicine or a recognition obtained by the Medical Professions Commission (MEBEKO) - Benefit from knowledge of the Vaudian and Swiss health care system - Have completed one year of optional training (research in ophthalmology, internal medicine or surgery, other) - Mastering French in both oral and written at B2 level - Have analytical, synthesis and organizational capabilities - Be prepared to engage personally, show tenacity and stress resistance - Be flexible, have relational ease and a good ability to work as a team --- Cosa offeriamo - A rewarding activity in a dynamic environment where you can showcase your talents and professional skills - Post-graduate training structured according to ISFM criteria - Wage conditions based on the rates in the canton of Vaud --- Informazioni pratiche - Tasso di attività: 100% - Tipo di contractto: CDI - Durata del contractto: The duration of the appointment is linked to the training plan for Vaudian medical assistants and clinical leaders, according to art. 10 of the Collective Labour Agreement of 21.12.2016 - Data di inizio: 01.11.2027 or to be defined - Luogo di lavoro: Jules Gonin Ophthalmic Hospital, Lausanne --- Contatto - Riferimento: Ms Valentine de Preux, Medical Directorate - Telefono: 021 626 85 82 --- Important notei - In case of commitment, you must provide us with a standard and special criminal record. - In case of interest for the above-mentioned position, please apply EXCLUSIVELY ONLINE and by informing all fields. - Only complete applications (letter of motivation, CV with photo, copies of diplomas and recognition of diploma by MEBEKO, certificates of training and master's degree in French level B2 for non-French speakers, letters of recommendation and certificates of work) will be considered.

Descrizione Die 1843 in Lausanne gegründete Stiftung für Blinde umfasst das Jules-Gonin Augenkrankenhaus, eine universitäre Augenheilkunde, ein Forschungszentrum, das Pädagogische Zentrum für sehbehinderte Studierende (CPHV), den sozialen, Rehabilitations- und Sehbehinderungsdienst sowie das medizinisch-soziale Establishment Clair-Soleil. Description Founded in Lausanne in 1843, the Asile des aveugles Foundation includes the Jules-Gonin Ophthalmic Hospital, a university ophthalmology service, a research center, the Pedagogical Center for Visually Impaired Students (CPHV), the social service, low vision rehabilitation, and the Clair-Soleil medico-social establishment. Over 650 staff members work daily in the field of visual health to provide diagnosis, treatment, and support services to people with visual impairments. Position To complete our low vision rehabilitation and social services department (SSRBV), we are looking for a - Low Vision Rehabilitation and Social Services Manager Your mission - You ensure the strategic and operational management of the SSRBV, guaranteeing the quality and coordination of visual rehabilitation services within the Foundation and hold the following responsibilities: - The activity rate includes a portion dedicated to clinical work related to low vision rehabilitation - Lead the service and supervise teams - Manage a multidisciplinary team of approximately 15 staff members, including specialized occupational therapists in low vision, optometrists, orthoptists, and social workers. - Promote interprofessional collaboration and a motivating work environment. - Work closely with administrative staff to ensure organizational efficiency. - Guarantee the quality and coordination of care - Ensure planning and coordination of follow-ups in visual rehabilitation. - Ensure the patient pathway is transversal, in connection with clinical teams and other entities of the Foundation. - Enhance patient experience. - Monitor activity and quality indicators of the service. - Contribute to the development of the low vision rehabilitation sector. - Lead continuous improvement projects aimed at strengthening organizational efficiency and service quality. - Support the development of a visual rehabilitation HUB within the hospital, in collaboration with Foundation professionals. - Strengthen early identification and referral processes for individuals at risk of visual impairment. - Develop partnerships - Develop and maintain close collaborations with various Foundation entities and partners in the care and rehabilitation network. Your strengths - HES degree in occupational therapy and a HES or university diploma in a relevant field, particularly in health, social sciences, rehabilitation, or management, with HES training in occupational therapy - Proven experience in team management within an interdisciplinary context. - Leadership and ability to motivate professionals with complementary expertise. - Significant interest or experience in low vision and visual rehabilitation.
• We offer - A rewarding and varied activity in a dynamic environment, with salary conditions commensurate with your skills. - Activity rate: 80% - 100% - Contract type: Permanent contract - Start date: To be agreed - Work location: Jules-Gonin Ophthalmic Hospital, Lausanne - Compensation: According to DECFO standards - Contact: Mr. Lucien Panchaud, Director of Community Health, 078 732 03 78 Contact [apply] Asile des aveugles Foundation — Jules-Gonin Ophthalmic Hospital, Lausanne (VD).
